title: 第15章 是谁偷偷送药又偷听第16章 和柔媚上
slug: 穿越庶长兄嫡弟竟是仙帝转世
content_zh:
开门一看，门外站着的竟是须发微霜、一脸促狭笑意的二长老云渊。“哟，小子，听说你被咱们那位小祖宗打得挺惨？”他毫不客气地挤进门，手里晃着一个精致的玉盒，“喏，老人家我心疼你，给你送好东西来了。”
云擎接过玉盒，有些无奈：“您老消息可真是灵通，些许小事，何必劳烦您亲自来一趟。”
“小事？”二长老吹胡子瞪眼，已经自顾自地在桌前坐下，给自己斟了杯灵茶。
“你小子可是族里的风云人物，都盯着你呢！这回来才几天？想踩你上位的，想巴结你的，还有想模仿你讨那位欢心的，嘿，群魔乱舞，那叫一个热闹。”他呷了口茶，语气带着看透世事的调侃。
云擎默然，打开二长老带来的玉盒。药香扑鼻，里面是三枚龙眼大小、通体琉璃金色、圆润无瑕的丹丸，正是天阶疗伤圣药——九转还玉丹。
他下意识运转重瞳看去，眉头不禁一挑，丹药内部，竟巧妙地缠绕着几缕精纯温和的煌阳之气，与他体内残留的狂暴气劲同源，正以一种玄奥的方式化开药力，显然是专门用于修复被煌阳神力所伤的经脉！
这丹药，分明是有人特意为他此刻的伤势炼制，绝非二长老平日的手笔。
二长老看着他恍然的神情，嘿嘿一笑，意味深长地点了点玉盒，又瞥向栖梧主殿的方向。那意思再明显不过，没有里面那位小祖宗的默许和暗示，他这老家伙，岂能随便踏入这位于栖梧后殿的静心院？
这药，是谁的意思，不言而喻。
云擎捏起一枚丹药，指尖触及温润的丹体，不再犹豫，直接将丹药送入口中。温和磅礴的纯阳药力瞬间化开，如甘霖涤荡经脉，所过之处，顽固的煌阳气劲被迅速中和、驱散，受损的经脉以肉眼可见的速度开始愈合，效果比他自己运功疗伤快了数倍不止。
更令他惊讶的是，这丹药中似乎还融入了一丝云煌对煌阳之力的感悟，让他疗伤之余，对这至阳至刚的力量，竟也生出了一丝模糊的亲近与体悟。
感受着体内迅速恢复的经脉，云擎握着玉盒，重瞳中闪过一丝复杂。
初回族中时，仅是靠近云煌便如受火焚，耗费许久才勉强压下暗伤；如今硬接一式煌阳印，反而得此灵药，这精心准备、药到伤除的待遇，和当初真可谓云泥之别。
他们之间那层坚冰，似乎真的在某种心照不宣的默契中，悄然融化了一丝。
栖梧殿内，云煌正批阅一份中州局势密报，他执笔的手微微一顿，感知到静心院里那道气息逐渐趋于平稳，那缕一直关注着静心院的神识才如同潮水般悄然退去。
云擎伤势尽复，状态甚至比受伤前更显凝练。他与二长老交换了一个眼神，确认那令人心悸的注视感已然消失。
云擎心念微动，终是忍不住传音入密问道：“二长老，您可知晓栖梧宫为何遍种‘清心藤’，可是那位…？”他顿了顿，没敢直接说出‘仙帝道心有缺’几字，纵然传音秘法乃是他与二长老因功体相合独创的，也实在不敢小觑一位仙帝转世的手段。
二长老闻言，脸上的嬉笑收敛了几分，他伸出食指，神秘兮兮地指了指天，又摆了摆手，意思是不可说，此事涉及天机。
“请神容易送神难啊。”二长老呷了口茶，同样传音入密，语气复杂“当年之举，本就是我云氏的一场豪赌，族里那些老家伙们，如今只怕巴不得有谁能蛊惑君心摘，让他对云氏多几分羁绊，最好留下血脉…”
云擎了然，不再追问这禁忌话题。他话锋一转，直接开口，声音在静心院内清晰响起：“二长老，关于今日宗祠镇魂碑一事，您如何看待？”

二长老挑了挑眉，意味深长地笑道：“现在就说这事？”不怕隔墙有耳了？他看着云擎意有所指。
云擎神色坦然，语气坚定：“擎对少君，知无不言。”
“哼！”
云擎话音刚落，凭空响起的冷哼如同冰霰击玉，清越剔透中带着能冻结神魂的寒意，正是云煌！
那声冷哼的意味不言自明——你二人方才在本君眼皮底下传音私语，转眼便说知无不言？真当本君耳聋目盲不成？
信你们才有鬼了。
“咳咳咳！”二长老脸上的笑容僵住一刹，眼角细纹都透着几分慌乱。他飞快转身，装作凝望院外月色，宽大的袖袍却“故意不小心”扫过云擎，指尖还偷偷勾了勾，一副“让你乱说，玩脱了吧”的埋怨模样。
云擎心头巨震，后背瞬间沁出冷汗，谁人不知这位少君脾气乖戾，最厌旁人在他面前耍小聪明。
只是两人紧张之余实在忍不住心中哀嚎：祖宗欸，您这偷听也来得太及时、太理直气壮了吧！
那道强横的神识毫不客气地扫过云擎全身，仿佛要将他里里外外看个通透。云擎强反应极快，面上迅速调整，露出一丝恰到好处的错愕与无奈，旋即化为一片坦荡，朝着栖梧殿主殿方向深深躬身，声音清越如泉：
“回少君，方才与二长老传音，所言不过伤势琐碎，实不敢以此等微末私事，扰了少君清修静听。然宗祠之事，关乎族内安定，擎既蒙少君信重，自当摒除私谊，坦诚相报，绝无半分隐瞒之心，亦不敢因私废公，辜负少君。”
他这番话说得滴水不漏，之前传音是“不愿以私事叨扰”，此刻汇报则是“出于公心与忠诚”，公事私情都被他一通放低姿态的陈情讲完了，相当滑不溜手。
静心院内霎时陷入沉静，只有夜风拂过竹叶的簌簌声。那股来自主殿的压迫感缓和了些许，却还在云擎身上逡巡不去，显然云煌还在“听”着。
二长老见状，连忙打圆场，嘀嘀咕咕道：“行了行了，小祖宗听着呢，有话快说有屁……咳咳，有事快禀！别耽误少君修行时间。”他这话看似粗俗，实则是给兄弟二人各自递了个台阶。

content_en:
When he opened the door, he saw the second elder Yunyuan standing outside the door with a slightly frosty beard and a narrow smile on his face. "Hey, boy, I heard that you were beaten badly by our little ancestor?" He squeezed in unceremoniously through the door, holding an exquisite jade box in his hand, "Well, I feel sorry for you, old man, and I have sent you something good."
Yun Qing took the jade box and said with some helplessness: "You are really well-informed about this matter. Why should I bother you to come in person for such a trivial matter?"
"A trivial matter?" The second elder blew his beard and glared. He sat down at the table and poured himself a cup of spiritual tea.
"Your boy is a prominent figure in the clan, and they are all staring at you! How many days have you been back here? Those who want to step on you to get the upper hand, those who want to curry favor with you, and those who want to imitate you to please that person. Hey, the demons are dancing around, it's really exciting." He took a sip of tea, and his tone was ridiculed with a knowing look at the world.
Yun Qing was silent and opened the jade box brought by the second elder. The aroma of the medicine is fragrant, and inside are three dragon-eye-sized, glazed golden, round and flawless elixir pills, which are the heaven-level holy medicine for healing—Nine Turns of Returning Jade Pills.
He subconsciously turned his eyes to look, and he couldn't help but raise his brows. Inside the elixir, there were actually a few strands of pure and gentle Huang Yang Qi, which had the same origin as the violent energy remaining in his body. They were using a mysterious method to release the power of the medicine, which was obviously specially used to repair the meridians damaged by the Huang Yang divine power!
This elixir was clearly made by someone specifically for his current injury, and it was definitely not the work of the second elder.
The second elder looked at his stunned expression, chuckled, tapped the jade box meaningfully, and glanced in the direction of the Qiwu main hall. The meaning is obvious. Without the tacit consent and hints of the little ancestor inside, how could he, an old guy, casually step into the Jingxin Courtyard located in the back hall of Qiwu?
It is self-evident who meant this medicine.
Yun Qing picked up an elixir, touched the warm elixir with his fingertips, and put the elixir directly into his mouth without hesitation. The gentle and majestic power of the pure yang medicine melted away instantly, washing the meridians like sweet rain. Wherever it passed, the stubborn bright yang energy was quickly neutralized and dispersed. The damaged meridians began to heal at a speed visible to the naked eye, and the effect was several times faster than his own healing.
What surprised him even more was that this elixir seemed to contain a trace of Yunhuang's understanding of the power of the radiant sun, which allowed him to have a vague affinity and understanding of the power of the radiant sun while healing his wounds.
Feeling the rapidly recovering meridians in his body, Yun Qing held the jade box, a hint of complexity flashed in his eyes.
When he first returned to the clan, just being close to Yunhuang felt like he was being burned by fire. It took him a long time to suppress the hidden wounds. Now, he received a Brilliant Sun Seal and received this elixir instead. This meticulous preparation and the treatment that healed the wounds were really different from those before.
The ice between them seemed to have quietly melted in some kind of tacit understanding.
In the Qiwu Hall, Yunhuang was reviewing a secret report on the situation in Zhongzhou. His hand holding the pen paused slightly, and he felt that the aura in the Jingxin Courtyard gradually stabilized, and the spiritual consciousness that had been paying attention to the Jingxin Courtyard quietly receded like the tide.
Yun Qing recovered from his injuries and his condition was even more condensed than before the injury. He exchanged a look with the second elder to confirm that the heart-stopping gaze had disappeared.
Yun Qing's thoughts moved slightly, and finally he couldn't help but send a message into the secret and asked: "Second Elder, do you know why Qiwu Palace is full of 'Qingxin Vine', but who...?" He paused and did not dare to directly say the words 'The Immortal Emperor has a defective heart'. Even though the secret method of message transmission was created by him and the second elder due to the combination of their skills, he really did not dare to underestimate the method of reincarnation of an Immortal Emperor.
When the second elder heard this, the smile on his face subsided a bit. He stretched out his index finger, pointed to the sky mysteriously, and waved his hand, meaning that it was unspeakable, and this matter involved heavenly secrets.
"It's easy to invite gods but hard to send them away." The second elder took a sip of tea and also transmitted the message into the secret, with a complex tone, "What we did back then was originally a heroic act of my Yun family.Guess, those old guys in the clan are just hoping that someone can seduce Jun Xinzhao and make him feel more bound to the Yun family. It's best to leave their bloodline..."
Yun Qing understood and stopped asking about this taboo topic. He changed the topic and spoke directly, his voice clearly echoing in the Jingxin Courtyard: "Second Elder, what do you think of the memorial monument in the ancestral hall today? "
The second elder raised his eyebrows and smiled meaningfully: "Are you talking about this now? "Aren't you afraid that the wall has ears? He looked at Yun Qing and meant something.
Yun Qing looked calm and spoke firmly: "Qing tells Shaojun everything he knows. "
"snort! "
As soon as Yun Qing finished speaking, the cold hum that sounded out of thin air was like ice hitting jade. It was clear and clear with a chill that could freeze the soul. It was Yun Huang!
The meaning of that cold snort is self-evident - you two just communicated and whispered under my nose, and in the blink of an eye you said you knew everything? Do you really think that I am deaf and blind?
I believe you are the one who has ghosts.
“Cough cough cough! "The smile on the second elder's face froze for a moment, and the fine lines in the corners of his eyes showed a bit of panic. He quickly turned around and pretended to stare at the moonlight outside the courtyard, but his large sleeves "deliberately and accidentally" swept across Yun Qing, and his fingertips even secretly hooked, with a look of complaint that said, "I let you talk nonsense, let's get rid of it."
Yun Qing's heart was shocked, and cold sweat suddenly broke out on his back. Who knew that this young gentleman had a bad temper and hated others trying to be clever in front of him.
It's just that the two of them were so nervous that they couldn't help but wailed in their hearts: Ancestor, your eavesdropping came too timely and so confidently!
That tyrannical consciousness swept over Yun Qing's body unceremoniously, as if he wanted to see him inside and out. Yun Qingqiang reacted very quickly, and quickly adjusted his face, revealing just the right amount of shock and helplessness, which immediately turned into magnanimity. He bowed deeply towards the main hall of Qiwu Hall, and his voice was as clear as a spring:
"Back to Young Master, I just communicated with the second elder. What he said was that the injury was trivial. I really don't dare to disturb Young Master's quiet listening with such trivial personal matters. However, the matter of the ancestral hall is related to the stability of the clan. Since Qing has the trust of the young master, he should put aside his personal friendship and repay the favor honestly. He should not hide anything at all, and he should not dare to let the young master down because of selfishness. "
What he said was impeccable. His previous message was that he "didn't want to bother me with personal matters," but now he was reporting "out of public interest and loyalty."
The Jingxin courtyard suddenly fell into silence, with only the rustle of the bamboo leaves in the night wind. The oppressive feeling from the main hall has eased a little, but it still lingers on Yun Qing. Obviously Yun Huang is still "listening".
Seeing this, the second elder quickly reconciled and muttered: "Okay, okay, little ancestor, listen, if you have something to say, say it quickly... Ahem, report it quickly! Don't delay Shaojun's cultivation time. "His words seemed vulgar, but in fact they gave the two brothers a step up.
